Increased vigil by Coast Guard along
Kerala coast
*203. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Coast
Guard has stepped up vigil along the coast
of Kerala following a tip off about an
unidentified vessel carrying arms from the
Gulf;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the Coast
Guard had increased its surveillance along
the Kerala coast in the last few days; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

Closure of loss making NTC mills
*201. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to close down 22 loss making National
Textile Corporation (NTC) mills in
Maharashtra;
(b) if so, how money will be arranged
to pay the workers compensation, VRS and
other terminal benefits; and
(c) the scheme chalked out for other
NTC mills in India?
Textiles exports
*202. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of TEXTILES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that he had made
a statement that our exports will double in
the next two years quelling fears that
cheaper Chinese products will hit the
Indian industry;
(b) how far we will benefit from the free

without toilets in their homes;
(b) whether there is any scheme for
assisting them in constructing Septic-tanks
and toilets; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Functioning of CISF at airports
*205. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Industrial Security Force (CISF) in the
South zone dealing with airport security
has set up an Information Feedback
Scheme to help air passengers;
(b) if so, the details of this scheme;
(c) whether it is also a fact that CISF
personnel do not operate all the X-ray and
other screening equipment leading to
delays at airports;
(d) what steps the CISF propose to
initiate to make our airports and air travel
efficient and time-conserving; and
(e) the details of steps proposed by
CISF to improve their functioning at
airports?
Construction of tunnel below Rohtang
pass
†*206. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the latest status of the work for
constructing a tunnel below Rohtang pass
near Manali in Himachal Pradesh;
(b) the proposed expenditure on this for
the current year alongwith the expenditure
incurred so far and total expenditure
estimated for constructing the tunnel; and
(c) whether its construction will be
completed during the Tenth Five Year Plan?
Law and order situation in Manipur
*207. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
institutionalised any concrete measures to
ensure that the kind of violent events
disturbing peace, law and order situation
in the State of Manipur recently, do not
occur again; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Construction of cantonment in
Bhadarwah
*208. DR. KARAN SINGH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been a  long
pending demand for the construction of a
cantonment in Bhadarwah, J&K; and
(b) if so, when this project is likely to
be completed?

rural development schemes

implementation of all the Rural
Development Programmes;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that some of the
States are receiving the next instalment of
funds from the Centre without submitting
the progress report;

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 15, 2004/Agrahayana 24, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power;
Rural Development; Textiles; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 130
Merger of Coast Guard in other wings
of Navy
1305. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA RAO:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Coast
Guard is working as a separate entity apart
from the Naval Forces;
(b) whether there is any proposal to
merge the Coast Guard with other wings
of the Navy;
(c) whether it is a fact that better
qualified and motivated personnel can be
sent on deputation from the Navy to the
Coast Guard; and
(d) the steps proposed to effect such a
merger to improve the Coast Guard?
Firing by Sri Lankan Navy on Indian
fishermen
1306. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Sri Lankan
Navy is patrolling the waters around
Kachatheevu Island, indulging in firing at
our fishermen, against the Kachatheevu
agreement;
(b) the steps taken by the Indian Navy
to protect Indian fishermen; and
(c) will Government press our Navy to
patrol around Kachatheevu to safeguard the
lives and boats of our fishermen?
Civilian casualties in landmines
1307. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
fact that according to a survey concluded
in March this year, the number of civilian
casualties caused by landmines in
Rajasthan, Punjab and Jammu following
the 2002 military build-up, adds upto an
alarming 779;
(b) whether Government is also aware
of the fact that once landmines are laid
under the ground, they remain potential
killers for decades, in peace as much as in

288
war and locating and defusing landmines
is a tedious and dangerous business; and
(c) if so, the reasons for India not
becoming member of Ottawa convention
that has a goal of a mine free world?
Modernisation of Ordnance factories
1308. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Ordnance factories are
getting damaged due to frequent fires;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken to modernize
Ordnance factories?
Reorganisation of Cantonment Boards
1309. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether all Cantonment Boards
have been reorganized;
(b) if so, whether representatives from
civil population have also been nominated
on the Boards; and
(c) if not, the places where such
nominations have yet not been done and
by when these are proposed to be
nominated with civilian representatives?
Establishment of Military Academy at
Barrackpore
1310. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any request from Government of West
Bengal for establishment of a Military
Academy at Barrackpore; and
(b) if so, Government's response
thereto?
Shifting of Hyderabad and
Secunderabad Cantonments
1311. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to shift
Hyderabad and Secunderabad
Cantonments to a far away place from the
city with modern amenities as a lot of
encroachment has already taken place;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government have received
the proposal of State Government to allot
fresh land for the construction of new
Cantonment Boards outside the city; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Acquisition of Erieye System by
Pakistan
1312. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Pakistan has
almost finalized a deal with Sweden to
acquire Erieye Radar System to match with
India's Phalcons;
(b) if so, how Erieye is effective than
Phalcons; and
(c) what is India's latest position of
acquiring Phalcons from Israel?
Acquisition of centrifuge for training of
IAF pilots
1313. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that IAF is going
to get new High G-Ultra modern human
centrifuge simulators for aggressive aircrew
training to its pilots;

289
(b) whether it is also a fact that this
proposal from IAF is pending in the
Ministry for quite some time;
(c) when the proposal was submitted to
the Ministry; and
(d) whether the new simulators are
going to be a replacement of old ones at
Delhi, Hyderabad and Bangalore?
Increase in defence budget
1314. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA: Will the Minister of DEFENCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made
heavy defence allocations in the current
year's Budget as compared to the last three
years’ Budget;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reasons for such a massive
increase?
Defence Secretary talks between India
and Pakistan
